items.title: Synthetic NTFS crash fixtures with auxiliary ntfsfix -n checks
items.note: Crash-replay fixtures remain synthetic mkntfs-based; ntfsfix -n is secondary evidence only, not a Windows/chkdsk oracle or replay-parity proof. The Windows VHDX + chkdsk harness includes bounded streaming $MFT/$BITMAP capture and comparison. The latest snapshot run exposed raw ReadFile WinError 87; the source now uses physically sector-aligned windows and fails closed if padding crosses the selected partition, with the rerun pending. Real Windows replay captures and replay-parity proof remain absent.
items.reproduced: 2026-11-17: tests/test_ntfs_crash_oracle_matrix.py covers five synthetic scenarios; focused process-kill/crash-matrix tests: 15 passed; ntfsfix -n is secondary evidence only. Windows run 44016475448 on windows-latest produced the native chkdsk artifact (clean /scan, dirty-volume /scan with typed exit 13, /f repair, clean post-repair /scan, and unchanged sentinel SHA-256). Run 44052870716 identified WinError 87 during $BITMAP raw-device capture; sector-aligned reads and partition-bound checks are implemented, and 95 targeted tests passed locally. Windows rerun is pending; no result establishes real Windows crash captures or NTFS replay parity; C6 remains partial.
